blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Financial forensic analyst Atty. Alexander Cabrera has assured Senator-judge Robinhood “Robin” Padilla that he can come up with a competent report even in a limited amount of time, amid questions on why it seems that the report on Vice President Sara Duterte’s finances was made hastily. During the latter part of Duterte’s impeachment trial on Monday, Padilla asked Cabrera whether it was proper to do a financial analysis of Duterte’s financial transactions in a short amount of time when he was dealing with a high-ranking official elected by over 30 million Filipinos.
